newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Bildt to return to Swedish politics in '97 - paper.
newsitem.headline: Bildt to return to Swedish politics in '97 - paper.

text.p: International Bosnia peace coordinator Carl Bildt says he will return to Swedish politics next spring, Swedish daily Goteborgs Posten said on Friday.
Bildt, 47, said he could not specify exactly when he would reassume his position as Swedish conservative party leader full time, but added he had no doubts about returning.
"I will definitely be back in Sweden in the spring," Bildt, a former prime minister, told the newspaper.
Bildt became the major powers' High Representative in Bosnia in December 1995 after a six-month spell as the European Union mediator in the region.

He served as Sweden's prime minister between 1991 and 1994, leading a centre-right coalition in a rare interruption to the Social Democratic rule which returned after Bildt was defeated in the September 1994 election.
